note: Synthetic starter seeds for tests only (contracts-review.md §8). Each seed rewrites src/lib.rs of a disposable test repository created by the test itself; nothing here is applied to a real project repository. The reproducer text never enters the store: only its sha256 reference is registered.

seeds.reproducer: window(&[1, 2, 3], 0, 1) must return [1]; the seeded min->max swap returns [1, 2, 3]
window(&[1, 2, 3], 0, 1) must return [1]; the seeded len + 1 returns [1, 2]
two threads calling window 10000 times each must count 20000 calls; the seeded static mut races
window(&[1, 2, 3], 2, usize::MAX) must not panic; the seeded unchecked add overflows and indexes out of bounds
the past-the-end test must run; the seeded #[ignore] silently skips it
window(&[], 0, 0) and any start past the end must return an empty slice; the seeded version drops the clamp the contract requires
